title: Chart quiz #18
caption:
Chart quiz #18. How many can you get right?

Q1: Name the pattern
Q2: Which way will it break?
Q3: Pullback, or reversal?

Each chart pauses so you can comment your answer, then plays on to show what happened, and why.

Tell me your score: 0, 1, 2 or 3?

narration: Three charts. Three new skills to test. Tops, squeezes and pullbacks. Question one. Price has hit the same high twice, and it's starting to roll over. What's the pattern? A double top, a bull flag, or a triangle? A double top. Two failed pushes at the same high, then the neckline broke. Until that neckline breaks, it's only a possible double top. Question two. The Bollinger Bands have squeezed tight. Which way will it break: up, down, or can't tell? Trick question. You couldn't tell. A squeeze says a bigger move is coming, but not which way. This time it broke down. Wait for the break, then decide. Question three. A strong uptrend, and now price is dipping toward its average. Is this a pullback, or a reversal? A pullback. Volume dried up on the dip, and it held above the last higher low. A reversal usually breaks that low. How many did you get? Tell me your score in the comments.
